messages:
jessica (eng-oncall): quick handoff for the next 8h. main items from the postmortem follow-up:
- remediation PR merged (see link below)
- need verification that the kv-cache eviction fix stopped the memory climb on runtime-2
- canary latency should be observed for 4h

rahul (eng-sre): saw the PR land last night, running a short soak on staging now. initial logs look stable.

rahul (eng-sre): smoke log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T02:05:12Z runtime-2 INFO mem: resident=2.1G heap=1.8G cache=120M
2026-03-17T02:35:12Z runtime-2 INFO mem: resident=2.0G heap=1.7G cache=90M
```

tasha (eng-runtime): i'll run a longer soak (6h) and watch p95. if that goes green i'll promote the canary. ETA ~4h.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy to staging completed at 2026-03-17T03:21Z :white_check_mark:

amanda (eng-oncall): pinging QA to run the prompt-regression suite and the latency check (/cc @qa-team). also please verify the postmortem regression prompts.

rahul (eng-sre): reopening INC-20260310 for tracking until we get 24h stability — moving remediation-123 to in-progress. leaving monitoring alerts in place.

tasha (eng-runtime): small follow-up: older images didn't get the eviction flag by default, added fallback `--kv-cache-ttl=0` for them. PR created: https://git.redwood.example/redwood/runtime/pull/501

jessica (eng-oncall): noted. amanda, can you run a quick latency spot-check on staging? here's the curl i use:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq '.latency'
```

ci-bot: CI passed for pr/501 — all checks green :green_heart:

amanda (eng-oncall): running now, posting numbers shortly.

amanda (eng-oncall): results: median=42ms, p95=120ms, small variance vs baseline but within expected. marking as verified for the canary window.

rahul (eng-sre): I'll keep monitoring through 2026-03-18T03:21Z. if no regressions by then i'll close INC-20260310 and set remediation-123 to done.

tasha (eng-runtime): if you hit any regression in canary roll me a direct message and i can roll back the canary to previous image quickly.

jessica (eng-oncall): thanks everyone — handoff complete. leaving watch until rahul confirms closure. :wave:
